title: NoOne’s better HTTYD Dragons
description: NoOne’s better HTTYD Dragons is a Forge 1.18.2 mod that expands Isle of Berk dragons with custom abilities, wild behavior, gender, breeding, and optional support for Archipelago Additions and Alpha’s Rise variants.
body:
NoOne’s better HTTYD Dragons makes Isle of Berk dragons feel more unique and alive. It adds custom primary and secondary abilities for many dragon variants, including breath attacks, roars, dashes, venom, burrowing, swimming behavior, and special passive traits.
The mod also adds dragon gender, natural breeding, family behavior, baby protection, wild hunting, resting, swimming, and more species-flavored AI. Optional integrations allow Archipelago Additions and Alpha’s Rise dragons to gain their own abilities without requiring those add-ons to be installed.
